emblems.name: Assassin
emblems.attributes: Adaptive Penetration: +14, Adaptive Attack: +10, Movement Speed: +3%

emblems.name: Mage
emblems.attributes: Magic Power: +30, Cooldown Reduction: +5%, Magic Penetration: +8

emblems.name: Fighter
emblems.attributes: Spell Vamp: +10%, Adaptive Attack: +22, Hybrid Defense: +6

emblems.name: Support
emblems.attributes: Healing Effect: +12%, Cooldown Reduction: +10%, Movement Speed: +6%

Fatal.name: Fatal
Fatal.description: Gain 5% Critical Chance and 10% Critical Damage

Wilderness Blessing.name: Wilderness Blessing
Wilderness Blessing.description: Movement Speed Bonus in Jungle and River. Movement Speed in the Jungle and River is increased by 10%.

Seasoned Hunter.name: Seasoned Hunter
Seasoned Hunter.description: Speed up Jungling. Damage against Lord and Turtle is increased by 15%.

Tenacity.name: Tenacity
Tenacity.description: Defense Bonus when HP is low. When HP is below 50%, Physical & Magic Defense is increased by 15.

Master Assassin.name: Master Assassin
Master Assassin.description: Damage Bonus against lone enemies. When there is only one enemy hero nearby, damage to that hero is increased by 7%.

Bargain Hunter.name: Bargain Hunter
Bargain Hunter.description: Equipment Discount. Equipment can be purchased at 95% of its price.

Festival of Blood.name: Festival of Blood
Festival of Blood.description: Gain Spell Vamp from kills. Gain 6% Spell Vamp. Each kill or assist grants 0.5% extra Spell Vamp, up to 8 stacks.

Pull Yourself Together.name: Pull Yourself Together
Pull Yourself Together.description: Reduced Battle Spell & Equipment Cooldown. Battle Spell and Active Equipment Cooldown are reduced by 15%.

Weapon Master.name: Weapon Master
Weapon Master.description: Extra Attack Bonus. Physical Attack and Magic Power gained from Equipment, Emblems, Talents and Skills are increased by 5%.

Impure Rage.name: Impure Rage
Impure Rage.description: Extra Skill Damage and Mana Regen. Dealing damage with skills adds extra Adaptive Damage and restores 2% Mana on hit. (3% HP if no mana). Cooldown 5s.

Quantum Charge.name: Quantum Charge
Quantum Charge.description: Basic Attacks Grant HP Regen & Speed Up. Dealing damage with Basic Attacks increases Movement Speed by 30% for 1.5s and restores 75-180 HP.

Killing Spree.name: Killing Spree
Killing Spree.description: Regen and Speed Up After Kill. After killing an enemy hero, recover 15% Lost HP and gain 20% Movement Speed.

Lethal Ignition.name: Lethal Ignition
Lethal Ignition.description: Extra Damage on multi-hits. Dealing damage greater than 7% Max HP 3 times in 5s burns the target for extra damage.

Brave Smite.name: Brave Smite
Brave Smite.description: HP Regen on Skill Damage. Dealing Skill Damage to an enemy hero restores 4% Max HP. Cooldown 6s.

Focusing Mark.name: Focusing Mark
Focusing Mark.description: Damage Bonus for Allies. Dealing damage to an enemy hero increases allies' damage to them by 6% for 3s.

Weakness Finder.name: Weakness Finder
Weakness Finder.description: Basic Attacks slow down enemies. Basic Attacks have a chance to reduce target's Movement Speed by 90% and Attack Speed by 50%.

Concussive Blast.name: Concussive Blast
Concussive Blast.description: Area Damage after Basic Attack. After next Basic Attack, deal Magic Damage to nearby enemies based on HP. Cooldown 15s.

War Cry.name: War Cry
War Cry.description: Damage Bonus after 3 attacks. After dealing damage with Basic Attacks or Skills 3 consecutive times, all damage increased by 8% for 6s.

Temporal Reign.name: Temporal Reign
Temporal Reign.description: Reduced Ultimate Cooldown. Casting Ultimate reduces other skill's remaining cooldowns by 1.5 times. Cooldown 20s.
